we have identified 11 mutations in eight genes that are associated with primary cilia dyskinesia.

we have found that the Ashkenazi Jews have high carrier frequencies for several mutations in PCD genes, including the c.7502 mutation in DNAH5, the c.1304 mutation in DNAI2, the c.735 mutation in C21orf59, and the c.1303G>A mutation in CCDC40.

The main takeaway from our work is that

carrier frequencies for PCD-associated mutations in Ashkenazi Jewish populations are higher than previously reported and that the inclusion of these genes into existing clinical mutation panels should be considered.
